verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a first-party PII redaction feature in its observability guides that automatically detects and removes sensitive information from both call transcripts and audio recordings, which are the data it stores as call logs and traces. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that redaction happens before persistence rather than after ingestion, developer-configurable masking rules or SDK/tracing-level redaction hooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
